article.paragraph 1: Nunavut man killed by RCMP after live streaming that he wanted to 'die by police'
article.paragraph 2: 39-year-old 'confronted' police with gun in threatening manner, RCMP say
article.paragraph 3: A man in Hall Beach, Nunavut, was killed by police overnight after live streaming on social media that he wanted to "die by police."
article.paragraph 4: According to an RCMP news release, the incident started at about 11:30 p.m. Monday, when officers received a call about the man's live stream.
article.paragraph 5: RCMP say that after arriving at a home in the community, they were "confronted" by a 39-year-old man, who was holding a gun "in a threatening manner."
article.paragraph 6: They say they negotiated with the man and used de-escalation techniques, but he was ultimately shot by police and later died.
article.paragraph 7: The Ottawa Police Service will conduct an investigation.
article.paragraph 8: "These events are difficult for all involved. Our thoughts are with the family and community at this time," the news release said.
article.paragraph 9: Hall Beach, in the Qikiqtaaluk region of Nunavut, has a population of about 750. The mayor said people are "deeply affected by the incident."
article.paragraph 10: "People feel awful when someone dies unexpectedly. They feel sad that people die this way," Peter Siakuluk told CBC in Inuktitut.
article.paragraph 12: The man's video was broadcast live on Facebook for 22 minutes.
article.paragraph 13: In the video, the man is inside a home, behind the front door. He appears to be by himself.
article.paragraph 14: "I hope you're happy man. I hope you're happy," he says.
article.paragraph 15: "Suicide motherf--kers!" he yells. "This is how you do it. Suicide by cops."
article.paragraph 16: He appears to be crying at times, while he repeatedly wraps an object in a towel or blanket.
article.paragraph 17: "You want to take my family away from me?" he shouts at the camera. "You and your family, I hope you're happy.
article.paragraph 18: "You keep my family happy. You keep my family safe. I can't keep them safe."
article.paragraph 19: The live stream ended before the RCMP arrived.
